label: Sector relative momentum
desc: Ranking at the sector level rather than the asset class.
rule: five formation windows · rank within sector
config:
xs_sector_momentum:
  asset_classes:
  - crypto
  - futures
  - fx
  group_level: sector
  universe_filters:
  - type: ListingFilter
  - type: PrimaryOnly
  - type: HistoryFilter
    params:
      min_days: 252
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: AdvFilter
    params:
      min_adv: 50000000
      lookback: 63
  vol_estimator:
    type: EWMA2
    params:
      hl_1: 5
      hl_2: 10
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Identity
  signals:
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 1.0
    params:
      vol_estimator:
        type: EWMA2
        params:
          span: 32
      indicator:
        type: EWMATrend
        params:
          group_delay: 84
          n_stages: 2
      ranker:
        type: GroupNeutralRank
        params:
          min_group_size: 4
          inner:
            type: PercentileRank
            params:
              min_names: 4
      position_function:
        type: QuantilePortfolio
        params:
          long_pct: 0.3
          short_pct: 0.3
          weighting: equal
          dollar_neutral: true
      risk_weighting:
        type: InverseVol
        params:
          target_vol: 0.1
          floor: 0.05
  asset_allocator:
    type: Identity
  model_gearing:
    type: VolCorr
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      asset_vol_target: 0.1
      corr_lookback: 504
      signal_lookback: 0
      leverage_cap: 5.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 2.0
  rebalance: daily
  position_smoothing: 10
